note: Where this pipeline implements each ID the Dixit nutrition binding declares (rules, answer checks, intents, anchors, patch steps, conflicts, tests), and how completely. Statuses: implemented, partial, missing, not_applicable. Every declared ID must be mapped (python -m dixit_answer.binding and tests/test_binding.py check it); a status is an engineering claim, not a sign-off. BMAP-0.1.0 (27 Oct 2026): first map, written against binding 1.2.6 and the 25-prompt run of 27 Oct 2026.

NUT-ROUTE-001.note: Each food's records are chosen per environment in food_master.json, not ranked across sources per question; production uses USDA only until the Indian licence is recorded.

NUT-FALLBACK-001.note: Dish estimates from ingredients are labelled estimates (development only); there is no general reconstruction service for an unknown dish.

NUT-KNOWLEDGE-001.note: No approved condition-specific knowledge records yet (the nutrition knowledge base, plan phase 4).

NUT-GOLDEN-001.note: Golden Rules control the answer, but precedence is ordered in code, not read from the conflict registry.

NUT-STATUS-001.note: Neutral lookups do not ask; the 25-prompt run (#13) still asked a person whose profile says type 2 diabetes.

NUT-PRECISION-001.note: Values only from records; flagged or unclear servings give no number; energy ranges kept as ranges.

NUT-DATA-ELIGIBILITY-001.note: Quarantined and retrieval-ineligible records are dropped before anything else, with counts pinned.

NUT-USAGE-CONSTRAINT-001.note: 'Range only' energy and the carbohydrate/fibre pairing are applied; other constraint wordings are not parsed.

NUT-APPROX-001.note: Per-serving energy ranges are disclosed; per-100 g requests on Indian records are not served at all.

UNIV-PERSONAL-001.note: Medicine, cure, dose and child questions get fixed replies; no portions or plans.

PATCH-MOD-001.note: Status is asked only for status-dependent sub-intents, but topics come from word lists, not the declared topic list.

NUT-SRC-001.note: Every number is rendered from a record or a recorded calculation.

NUT-MATCH-001.note: A named dish we don't hold is said first, then dishes with its foods (fixed 27 Oct 2026, eval LP-05); the reconstruction half of the check (prepared record before ingredients) is still partial.

NUT-HIER-001.note: No India-first or USDA-first ranking in code; production is USDA-only by licence, a data-licence limit, not a ranking.

NUT-GR-001.note: A pack or lower rung can only tighten.

NUT-EDU-001.note: No condition knowledge to share yet (knowledge base).

NUT-PER-001.note: No portions, plans, doses or outcome promises.

NUT-UNC-001.note: Estimates are labelled; recipe assumed amounts are named.

NUT-FIELD-001.note: Only the listed nutrient fields are read; condition flags, insulin demand and GI/GL/FII are never loaded.

NUT-COMP-001.note: Answers are not composed in the binding's five layers (fact, serving, condition knowledge, protocol position, personal boundary).

NUT-DUP-001.note: duplicate_name_groups.json is not read; a dish name with materially different records is resolved by the food master's choice.

prepared_food_nutrient_lookup.note: Indian prepared dishes in development only.

meal_nutrient_estimation.note: No 'estimate my bowl' aggregation of several foods.

serving_conversion.note: No 'one cup vs 250 g' conversion answer.

ambiguous_food_identity.note: One clarification for an unknown word; no duplicate-record clarification.

ANCHOR_SAFETY_CLASSIFIED.note: Runs before intent classification, stricter than the flow order.

ANCHOR_SCENARIO_SELECTED.note: Scenarios SCN-089 and SCN-090 live in the Dixit baseline, which is not on this machine.

ANCHOR_PROTOCOL_BUNDLE_SELECTED.note: Programme wording is selected; baseline protocol bundles are not available.

ANCHOR_STORY_RETRIEVAL_COMPLETE.note: Success stories are Dixit baseline content, outside the nutrition plugin.

ANCHOR_MEDIA_RESOLVED.note: Exercise media is Dixit baseline content, outside the nutrition plugin.

ANCHOR_LOGGING.note: Data versions are logged; rule IDs, anchors and the binding's nine logging fields are not.

DIXIT-NUT-ORCH-001.note: Emits the eight declared sub-intents from the raw message (plus Swastham's own values for recipes, support and greetings).

DIXIT-NUT-ORCH-008.note: Overlapping checks exist; the 14 NUT checks are not run by ID.

CONF-NUT-001.note: Facts stay visible; the Golden Rule is stated as the protocol position.

CONF-NUT-002.note: Database condition labels are never loaded.

CONF-NUT-003.note: Two meals and the meal window are stated; frequent-meal advice is not given.

CONF-NUT-004.note: Status-specific fruit rule applied; see NUT-STATUS-001.

CONF-NUT-007.note: Neutral facts are answered without asking status.
